_note: GST rule pack (I5): how many HSN/SAC digits an invoice must carry, by aggregate turnover (Notification 78/2020-Central Tax).

explain.en: Turnover up to ₹5 crore in the previous year: 4 HSN digits on B2B bills (optional on B2C). Above ₹5 crore: 6 digits on every bill. SAC codes are 6 digits starting 99.
explain.hi-Latn: Pichle saal ₹5 crore tak ka turnover: B2B bill par 4 HSN digit (B2C par marzi). ₹5 crore se zyada: har bill par 6 digit. Service ka SAC 6 digit, 99 se shuru.
